out.text: Crossplay Guide checks which platforms play together for 260+ games. New answers and real updates show up here first.

🔄 Crossplay update: Forza Horizon 6

Forza Horizon 6 hits PS5 on January 26, 2027, with crossplay and cross-save with Xbox and PC.

🔄 Crossplay update: It Takes Two

It Takes Two crossplay is live: PC, PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One and Switch 2 can all play together.

🆕 Just checked: Active Matter

✅ Active Matter supports crossplay between PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and Linux.

🆕 Just checked: American Truck Simulator

❌ American Truck Simulator is only out on computers right now, so there is no console crossplay; the PS5 and Xbox Series X|S versions are announced but have no release date.

🆕 Just checked: Assetto Corsa

❌ The original Assetto Corsa has no crossplay: PC, PlayStation and Xbox players race online only with their own platform.

🆕 Just checked: Cult of the Lamb

❌ Cult of the Lamb has no crossplay because its co-op is local only: a second player joins as the Goat on the same screen.

🆕 Just checked: Cuphead

❌ Cuphead has no crossplay because it has no online mode: its 2-player co-op is local only.

🆕 Just checked: Dark Souls: Remastered

❌ Dark Souls: Remastered has no crossplay: Bandai Namco confirmed that players are matched only with others on the same platform.

🆕 Just checked: Deadzone: Rogue

✅ Deadzone: Rogue supports crossplay between PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and Nintendo Switch 2.

🆕 Just checked: Devil May Cry 5

❌ Devil May Cry 5 has no crossplay and no regular co-op: its only online feature, the Cameo System, randomly drops other players into your missions, and Capcom has never announced cross-platform support for it.

queue.text:
🆕 Just checked: Dying Light 2: Stay Human

Dying Light 2: Stay Human has crossplay, but players are split into 3 separate groups that can't meet: PC; PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 4; Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One.

🆕 Just checked: Enshrouded

❌ Enshrouded launched its 1.0 version on PC and PS5 without crossplay, so PC and PS5 players can only share worlds with people on the same platform.

🆕 Just checked: Enter the Gungeon

❌ Enter the Gungeon has no crossplay: co-op is local only on PC and consoles, and the online co-op added to the mobile version stays on mobile.

🆕 Just checked: Euro Truck Simulator 2

❌ Euro Truck Simulator 2 is only on computers for now, so there's no console crossplay; the PS5 and Xbox Series X|S versions don't have a release date yet.

🆕 Just checked: Fishing Planet

Fishing Planet has crossplay, but players are split into 5 separate groups that can't meet: PC; PC, Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One; PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 4; Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch; iPhone & i…

🆕 Just checked: Football Manager 26

✅ Football Manager 26 supports crossplay between PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One. PC is separate.

🆕 Just checked: Goat Simulator 3

Goat Simulator 3 has crossplay, but players are split into 2 separate groups that can't meet: PC; PC, Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One.

🆕 Just checked: Gunfire Reborn

✅ Gunfire Reborn supports crossplay between PC, Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One. PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5 are separate.

🆕 Just checked: Halloween: The Game

✅ Halloween: The Game supports crossplay between PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

🆕 Just checked: Infinity Nikki

✅ Infinity Nikki supports crossplay between PC, PlayStation 5, iPhone & iPad and Android.

🆕 Just checked: Lords of the Fallen (2023)

✅ Lords of the Fallen (2023) supports crossplay between PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

🆕 Just checked: Naraka: Bladepoint

✅ Naraka: Bladepoint supports crossplay between PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

🆕 Just checked: PlateUp!

PlateUp! has crossplay, but players are split into 2 separate groups that can't meet: PC, Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One; PC. PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch have no crossplay.

🆕 Just checked: Pummel Party

❌ Pummel Party has no crossplay: online lobbies on PC, PlayStation, Xbox and Switch each stay on their own platform.

🆕 Just checked: Sackboy: A Big Adventure

Sackboy: A Big Adventure has crossplay, but players are split into 2 separate groups that can't meet: PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 4; PC.

🆕 Just checked: Stellaris

✅ Stellaris supports crossplay between PC, Mac and Linux. PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S are separate.

🆕 Just checked: Strinova

❌ Strinova's global release is PC only; the PS5 and Xbox Series X|S versions announced for 2025 haven't launched, so there's no crossplay.

🆕 Just checked: Super Battle Golf

❌ Super Battle Golf is only on PC (Steam) right now; PS5, Xbox Series X|S and Switch 2 versions with full crossplay are promised for early 2027.

🆕 Just checked: Teardown

❌ Teardown's online multiplayer has no crossplay: PC, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S players only play with others on the same platform.

🆕 Just checked: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon Breakpoint

❌ Ubisoft confirms Ghost Recon Breakpoint has no crossplay: PC, PlayStation and Xbox players each play only with their own platform.

🆕 Just checked: Vigor

✅ Vigor supports crossplay between PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One.

🆕 Just checked: Watch Dogs 2

❌ Watch Dogs 2 has no crossplay: PlayStation, Xbox and PC players each play online only with their own platform.

🆕 Just checked: Wreckfest

Wreckfest has crossplay, but players are split into 3 separate groups that can't meet: PC; PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 4; Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One. Nintendo Switch has no crossplay.

🆕 Just checked: XCOM 2

❌ XCOM 2 has no crossplay, and its online multiplayer was switched off for Windows Steam players in March 2022.
